# `aitbc liquidity stakes`

List on-chain liquidity stakes for an address (#2361). Stake ids are ``liq_<tx_hash[:16]>`` of the deposit transaction — the wallet file's local liquidity records cannot be queried by id without this list.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc liquidity stakes [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--address` | text | — | no | Staker address (overrides --wallet-name) |
| `--wallet-name` | text | — | no | Wallet whose stakes to list |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID (default: node's configured chain) |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL (overrides config) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc liquidity stakes
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc liquidity stakes --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
